hero.filename: Harrisburg Int Airport with Pennsylvania ANG aircraft 1979.jpg
hero.caption:
An aerial slide photo of the U.S. Air Force 193rd Tactical Electronic Warfare Group station, Pennsylvania Air National Guard, at the Harrisburg International Airport, Pennsylvania (USA), in May 1979. 

The Three Mile Island Nuclear Generating Station after the March 1979 nuclear accident.
The future home of the 193rd is visable on the left side by the Susquehanna River near the top of the photo.
hero.alt:
An aerial slide photo of the U.S. Air Force 193rd Tactical Electronic Warfare Group station, Pennsylvania Air National Guard, at the Harrisburg International Airport, Pennsylvania (USA), in May 1979. 

The Three Mile Island Nuclear Generating Station after the March 1979 nuclear accident.
The future home of the 193rd is visable on the left side by the Susquehanna River near the top of the photo.

images.filename: TMI-2 control room.png
images.caption: Three Mile Island Nuclear Plant, Pennsylvania, 1979.  TMI-2 control room several days after the start of the accident. The man in the foreground wearing a helmet is Charles Gallina, NRC inspector from Region I. The two men above Gallina are Craig Faust and William Zewe, both of whom were on duty when the accident began.
images.alt: Three Mile Island Nuclear Plant, Pennsylvania, 1979.  TMI-2 control room several days after the start of the accident. The man in the foreground wearing a helmet is Charles Gallina, NRC inspector from Region I. The two men above Gallina are Craig Faust and William Zewe, both of whom were on duty when the accident began.
